name: GPT-4o and GPT-4.1 shut down on 14 Jan 2027; move to gpt-6-luna
gain: Requests fail after 14 Jan 2027. OpenAI's listed gpt-6-luna price is $0.10 / $0.50 per 1M tokens, against gpt-4o's $2.50 / $10 and gpt-4o-mini's $0.15 / $0.60.
how: Change the id to gpt-6-luna. Set reasoning effort to none if the call sends temperature, top_p or tools on Chat Completions, and run your tests first.
replaces: gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4.1, gpt-4.1-mini and their dated snapshots
trade_offs: Unless reasoning effort is none, gpt-6-luna rejects temperature, top_p and top_logprobs.
On Chat Completions it supports function calling only with reasoning effort none.
Answer quality on your prompts is unmeasured, and a cheaper model can be a worse fit.
needs: Nothing new; the same OpenAI key.
price: gpt-6-luna $0.10 input, $0.01 cached input, $0.50 output per 1M tokens.
